_doc: Per-car audit of the 48 kept Toyota SUSPECTS (owner scrapped 43 of 91). Suspect = the material classifier could not find one clean body paint. Verdicts here carry TWO axes, because they are independent: geometry quality, and whether the car can recolour at all. A car can be visually excellent and still be unable to serve 8 DVLA colours -- which is most of Tier B's value.

_verdicts.PASS-SINGLE: good geometry but cannot recolour as detected -- ships single-neutral in its source colour unless the body material is identified by hand
_verdicts.FAIL: geometry below bar / broken / out of scope

1.name: 2007 Toyota Yaris
1.note: tyres missing from all four corners with bare hubs exposed, one wheel detached and floating beneath the car. Body itself is clean but the wheels are gone

2.name: 2010 Toyota Land Cruiser
2.note: geometry is genuinely good -- J200 proportions right, black alloys consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. BUT mats=0/cov=0.000: the classifier found no body paint, the forced silver never applied, and it renders its own white. Ships single-neutral, or recolours only if the body material is identified by hand. HUMSTER3D plate

3.name: Toyota Auris wagon
3.note: Auris Touring Sports; proportions right, multi-spoke wheels consistent, shut lines defined, headlight internals present. mats=0 so the forced silver never applied and it renders its own gloss black. FLAG: bonnet and flanks show visible panel ripple -- gloss black exaggerates this, so worth a second look before it ships. Finnish plate FMR-757

4.name: Toyota Avensis Estate MK2 2003-2009
4.note: body renders TRANSPARENT -- the panels carry a glass/transmissive material and you can see straight through the car. That is why mats=0 found no paint: there is none to find. Unusable as-is

5.name: Toyota Avensis Sedan MK1 1997-2003
5.note: body renders TRANSPARENT -- glass/transmissive material on the panels, same defect as #4 and #6 from the same uploader's Avensis set

6.name: Toyota Avensis Sedan MK2 2003-2009
6.note: body renders TRANSPARENT -- same glass-material defect as #4 and #5

7.name: Toyota Avensis Sedan MK3 2009-2012
7.note: T270 Avensis, and a generation the clean set does not cover (it had T220 and T250 only). Proportions right, black multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille slats crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. mats=0 so it renders its own white; recolour needs the body material identified by hand

13.name: 2025 Toyota Camry
13.note: 2025 Camry XV80; multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille mesh has depth, headlight LED internals sharp, shut lines defined. mats=3 so the stamp decides whether it ships 8 colours or falls back

14.name: 2021 Toyota RAV4 Prime PHEV
14.note: RAV4 Prime PHEV; black alloys consistent, grille mesh deep, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined. REDUNDANT with the already-published #57 (same model and year, different mesh) -- only worth taking if it beats what is live

17.name: 1976 Toyota Celica GT
17.note: the split-material failure made visible -- mats=8 and the respray caught only some panels, so it renders hard-edged HALF RED, HALF SILVER across a single wing. Geometry is fine (chrome wheels consistent, round headlights, period-correct shut lines) but no colour ships from this until the 8 body materials are consolidated. French plate DM-200-CP

18.name: Toyota Hilux SRX 2019
18.note: wheels render as flat black voids in all four views -- the spoke detail is gone and the arches read as hollow holes. Body geometry is sound, so this is a wheel-material fault, but it looks wrong as it stands

16.name: Toyota GR86 (ZN8)
16.note: GR86 ZN8; black alloys consistent in all four views, grille mesh deep, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined. REDUNDANT with the live #7 (same ZN8 generation)

19.name: 2023 Toyota bZ4X
19.note: 2023 bZ4X; silver multi-spoke wheels consistent, black cladding correct, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined. REDUNDANT with the live #10

22.name: Toyota Corolla Cross
22.note: REPLACEMENT CANDIDATE for the live Corolla Cross that failed its recolour. Different mesh (419,710f vs 597,245f) and cov=0.490 against the failed car's split. Geometry is good: two-tone multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille mesh deep, headlight internals sharp, cladding correct. mats=2 so it still needs the stamp, but it is the obvious thing to try before hand-fixing the live one

26.name: 2020 Toyota Yaris Cross
26.note: NEW NAMEPLATE -- Yaris Cross is not in the live catalogue at all. Dark multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, cladding correct, grille mesh deep, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. cov=0.511. UK-market car and a genuine gap fill

73.name: Toyota Hiace 2000 /Foyota Hiace 2000
73.note: photogrammetry scan -- wavy panel edges, lumpy surfaces, blobby headlights, no shut lines anywhere, cov=1.000 from a single baked texture. 'No scan mush' is the standing bar

74.name: Toyota Hiace Grand Cabin 2000
74.note: photogrammetry scan, high-roof Grand Cabin. Same soft geometry, plus the badge decal reads 'TOTOVA' not Toyota -- shipping that would be visibly wrong

75.name: Toyota Hiace Microbus Port Said Al-5000 Line
75.note: photogrammetry scan, two-tone white/blue. Same mush, with torn geometry visible in the window openings

78.name: Toyota Hiace Microbus Port Said Al-5000 Line
78.note: photogrammetry scan, fourth distinct van (plate GS1425). Same soft melted panels and absent shut lines

34.name: 2021 Toyota GR Yaris
34.note: NEW NAMEPLATE and excellent -- stock 2021 GR Yaris. Black multi-spoke wheels with red calipers identical in all four views, grille mesh has real depth, headlight LED internals sharp, shut lines crisp, premium reflections. cov=0.543. This is the car #47 could not be: that one was a Rocket Bunny widebody, out of scope

67.name: Toyota Aygo 2009 5-doors
67.note: photogrammetry scan with THE GROUND PLANE BAKED INTO THE MESH -- the car sits on a slab of scanned cobblestone that is part of the geometry and would render as a floating slab in the viewer. Lighting and shadows baked into the texture, soft panels, no shut lines, blobby headlights

_glass_set: #4/#5/#6 are one uploader's Avensis set and all three render transparent -- the panels carry a glass material. #7 from a different source is fine. A material defect can be uploader-wide, so when one car in a titled series fails this way, check its siblings.
_priority: Of the 32 remaining, only 11 fill a nameplate gap; 21 duplicate something already live. Auditing the gaps first: Yaris Cross, GR Yaris, Corona Premio, Carina, MR2 Spyder, Verso, Aygo, Hiace x4. The 21 duplicates are only worth taking if they beat the published car.
_dedup_blindspot: The four Hiaces all sit within 252 faces of exactly 1,000,000 because each was DECIMATED TO A 1M TARGET -- they are four different vans (different plates, trims, two-tones), not one mesh. Face-count dedup silently converges on decimated-to-target meshes and stops discriminating there. Verified all four by eye rather than grouping them; all four are scans and all four fail.
